newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Dec future contract above the 105 level.
newsitem.headline: Spain Dec future contract above the 105 level.

text.p: The Meff December future contract on 10 year bonds reached a new record high on Friday at 105.07 breaking the psychological level of 105.00.
The contract dipped immediately thereafter, at 0925 GMT, back to 104.96. Earlier dealers said they expected the market to reach such a level but they added profit-taking could emerge there.
Chartists put resistance at 105.15, then at 105.25. Supports are at 104.80, and 104.50.
The 10-year spread over Bunds dipped to 201, while dealers said it could narrow quickly under the 200 basis points level.
